free_tier.stated: Node-hour allocations on a cluster of dual EPYC hosts with Instinct accelerators, awarded quarterly by proposal, reachable over SSH at hpcfund.amd.com with Slurm. The vendor states: 'Node-hour based allocations are awarded quarterly to proposal submissions supporting innovative, impactful, open-source AI and HPC research', and 'Successful proposals receive cluster access for up to one year'. The enrollment page closes the loop: 'Membership is open exclusively to faculty and researchers at universities and research institutions worldwide. Enroll using your official academic email address - personal emails won't qualify.'

chaining: None for a user. The sibling AMD Developer Cloud lane, recorded separately, is the only AMD route with no institution gate, and it is 25 hours rather than a node-year.

limits.value: the AMD University Program enrolls only faculty and researchers at institutions, on an official academic email, and personal addresses are refused, so the quarterly proposal review is never reached.
